audit.species: human (Chan 2007 and Romagnani 2007 use human PB/LN NK cells; the Chan in vivo arm is a XENOGENEIC transfer of human cells into NOD-SCID mice). Counter-evidence species: rhesus macaque (Wu 2018), human (Mace 2013), mouse + human (Ding 2024).
audit.what_was_measured: Chan 2007 (from abstract + Cichocki 2019's methods-level description; Methods themselves NOT read): in human healthy-adult peripheral blood, CD3-CD56brightCD16- and CD3-CD56dimCD16+ NK cells were prospectively FACS-sorted and then (a) co-cultured with primary human synovial fibroblasts +/- an FGFR1-blocking antibody, with surface CD56/CD16, intracellular perforin, IFN-gamma and K562 lysis read out by flow cytometry; a parallel cytokine-only condition (IL-2 + IL-15 + 721.221 cells) was run and did NOT induce the phenotype change; (b) sorted CD56bright cells were injected into NOD-SCID mice and, at day 10, surface CD56 and CD16 on recovered human cells were scored by flow cytometry in blood, spleen and lymph node ("almost uniformly CD56dimCD16+"); (c) telomere length was measured in freshly isolated CD56bright vs CD56dim by flow-cytometric FISH. Romagnani 2007 (abstract only): sorted human PB CD56brightCD16-KIR- NK cells were cultured with IL-2/IL-15/IL-12 and surface KIR, CD16 and CD56 were re-stained; flow-FISH telomere length was compared between PB CD56dim and PB/lymph-node CD56bright from donors; KIR and CD16 surface staining was compared across non-reactive lymph node, hyperplastic/reactive lymph node, efferent lymph and peripheral blood. Ouyang 2007 (abstract only): flow-FISH telomere fluorescence in CD56dimCD16+ vs CD56brightCD16- NK cells sorted from the same adult donor, across a donor age range. Domaica 2012 (Methods read in full): in ONE paediatric-to-adolescent patient with melanoma plus opportunistic fungal infection and in healthy adult controls, PBMC were stained for CD3/CD56/CD16/CD57/CD158/CD62L/perforin/NKp46/NKG2D/DNAM-1/2B4/CD94-NKG2A and analysed on a FACSAria, at baseline and after overnight IL-12+IL-15+IL-18 or 5-day IL-2/IL-15 culture, with intracellular IFN-gamma and surface CD107a as functional readouts.

Romagnani 2007: donor number NOT STATED in the abstract; Methods unreadable. Ouyang 2007: donor number NOT STATED in the abstract. Domaica 2012: n = 1 patient, compared with an unspecified number of healthy adult (age 25-30) controls. COUNTER-EVIDENCE n (verified): Wu 2018 = 3 rhesus macaques (ZH33, ZG66, ZJ31), barcodes tracked 49-52 months; Mace 2013 = 8 GATA2-deficient patients.
audit.n_unit: donors (Chan/Romagnani/Ouyang — counts unobtainable); mice (Chan NOD-SCID arm — count unobtainable); patients (Domaica n=1; Mace n=8); animals (Wu n=3 macaques)
audit.controls: Chan 2007 (as described in abstract + Cichocki 2019): parallel sorted CD56dim subset cultured under the same conditions; an FGFR1-blocking antibody arm vs presumed isotype; a cytokine/target-cell-only arm (IL-2 + IL-15 + 721.221) that did NOT produce conversion — a genuinely informative negative control; CD56dim as the paired comparator for telomere flow-FISH. NO control reported for the NOD-SCID arm in any text I could read: no transferred-CD56dim comparator described, no congenic/clonal marking, no purity figure, no day-0 input phenotype. Romagnani 2007: same-donor CD56dim comparator for telomere; unstimulated CD56bright as the baseline; CD56dimKIR- cells as a comparator for KIR induction (and KIR was induced on CD56dim too, which weakens KIR as a maturation marker). Ouyang 2007: internal-control cells in the same flow-FISH tube; same-donor CD56dim vs CD56bright pairing. Domaica 2012: initially age-matched healthy donors, later young-adult (25-30) healthy donors; paired t-test within donor between subsets. NOT CONTROLLED anywhere: the possibility that sorted "CD56bright" inocula carry contaminating CD56dim cells that are then selected/expanded; and the possibility that surface CD56 (NCAM1) density is an activation-state variable rather than a lineage mark.
audit.strongest_alternative_explanation: A PRE-EXISTING CD56dim SUBSET IS SELECTED AND EXPANDED, NOT CONVERTED. CD56dim cells are ~90% of blood NK cells, so even a 1-2% CD56dim carry-over in a sorted CD56bright inoculum is, in absolute terms, a substantial CD56dim population. Over 10 days in a NOD-SCID xenograft — a severe survival bottleneck with no human IL-15 and no HLA-matched stroma — preferential survival/homeostatic expansion of that contaminant would reproduce the exact reported readout ("almost uniformly CD56dimCD16+ in blood, spleen and lymph node") with zero conversion of any cell. Chan 2007 used no clonal marking, so the design cannot distinguish conversion from selection, and I could not read the sort purity. The same alternative applies to the fibroblast co-culture arm (only "a fraction" of cells lost CD56) and, in the reverse direction, to Romagnani 2007, where KIR was induced on CD56dimKIR- cells as well — i.e. the "maturation markers" track activation, not lineage. SECOND ALTERNATIVE (technical/state, not lineage): surface CD56/NCAM1 density is a modulable activation-state variable, so "CD56bright becomes CD56dim" may be reversible phenotypic modulation of one population rather than an irreversible maturation step; note that Chan's fibroblast contact and Romagnani's cytokines gave OPPOSITE answers about whether cytokines drive the change, which Cichocki 2019 flags as an unexplained discrepancy. THIRD ALTERNATIVE (two independent origins): CD56bright and CD56dim are separately maintained lineages arising from distinct progenitors — now directly supported by clonal barcoding in macaques and by two-pathway (ENKP vs ILCP) NK ontogeny in mice. FOURTH (for the reconstitution-kinetics leg): post-HSCT CD56bright predominance at 1 month giving way to CD56dim by 3 months is equally explained by lymphopenia-driven homeostatic expansion of CD56bright followed by its normalisation — stated explicitly in Cichocki/Grzywacz/Miller Front Immunol 2019.
audit.counter_evidence: 1) Wu C, Espinoza DA, Koelle SJ, ... Bryceson YT, Dunbar CE. "Clonal expansion and compartmentalized maintenance of rhesus macaque NK cell subsets." Sci Immunol 2018;3(29):eaat9781. PMID 30389798 / PMC7393805. Autologous transplant of lentivirally barcoded CD34+ HSPCs in 3 rhesus macaques; CD56+CD16- and CD56-CD16+ NK cells FACS-sorted to >98% purity; barcodes tracked 49-52 months. Verbatim: "the barcode composition of CD56+CD16- and CD56-CD16+ NK cells remained distinct under homeostatic conditions over several years"; "these biased clonal patterns are difficult to explain via continuous ongoing production of terminally-differentiated short-lived rhesus CD56-CD16+ NK cells from HSPC via maturation through CD56+CD16- NK cells"; abstract: "linear NK cell production from multipotent hematopoietic progenitors or less mature CD56+CD16- cells is negligible during homeostasis and moderate proliferative stress." This is a clonal-marking design (OBS_DIRECT class) — a STRONGER evidence class than anything supporting the claim — and it points the other way. Predecessor: Wu C et al. Cell Stem Cell 2014;14:486-99, PMID 24702997. 2) Mace EM, Hsu AP, Monaco-Shawver L, ... Holland SM, Orange JS. "Mutations in GATA2 cause human NK cell deficiency with specific loss of the CD56bright subset." Blood 2013;121(14):2669-77. PMID 23365458 / PMC3617632. n = 8 GATA2-deficient patients: "The NK cells detected in peripheral blood of some GATA2-deficient patients are exclusively of the CD56dim subset"; in vitro CD34+ differentiation from patient cells likewise gave "NK cells... exclusively within the CD56dim compartment" while controls contained a CD56bright population; in vivo IFN-alpha raised NK numbers "but did not correct the paucity of CD56bright cells." Humans maintaining a CD56dim pool with essentially no CD56bright pool is incompatible with CD56bright being the obligate precursor. 3) Ding Y, Lavaert M, Grassmann S, ... Sun JC, Bhandoola A. "Distinct developmental pathways generate functionally distinct populations of natural killer cells." Nat Immunol 2024;25(7):1183-92. PMID 38872000 (Author Correction PMID 38987653). Two independent progenitors (ENKP, ILCP) generate distinct NK subsets in mice, and "Human CD56dim and CD56bright NK cells were transcriptionally similar to ENKP_NK cells and ILCP_NK cells, respectively" — i.e. the two human subsets map onto two SEPARATE developmental pathways rather than a precursor-product pair (human arm is INF_MARKER; mouse arm uses transfer/fate mapping). 4) Cichocki F, Grzywacz B, Miller JS. Front Immunol 2019;10:2078. PMID 31555287 (OA, read in full). The field's own assessment: "The presumed developmental transition from a CD56bright to a CD56dim phenotype is perhaps the most controversial step in this developmental model"; gives the homeostatic-expansion alternative for the post-HSCT kinetics; and notes "it's somewhat surprising that no follow up studies looking deeper into the FGF signaling pathway and its role in driving NK cell maturation have been published" — i.e. the Chan 2007 mechanism has stood unreplicated for ~19 years. 5) NEGATIVE FINDING ABOUT A COMMONLY CITED SUPPORT: Zhang Y, Wallace DL, ... Macallan DC. Immunology 2007;121:258-65, PMID 17346281 — the human in vivo deuterated-glucose NK kinetics study — sorted CD3-CD16+ NK cells ONLY and did not resolve CD56bright vs CD56dim, so it supplies no bright-to-dim kinetic evidence despite being cited in that role.
audit.downstream_dependency: 1) THE FREUD/CALIGIURI FIVE-STAGE HUMAN NK DEVELOPMENT MODEL. Stage 4 = CD56bright and Stage 5 = CD56dim; the stage-4-to-stage-5 arrow IS this claim. The model is the standard framework for staging human NK development in bone marrow, tonsil and lymph node (Freud AG et al. J Exp Med 2006;203:1033-43, PMID 16606675; Freud AG, Mundy-Bosse BL, Yu J, Caligiuri MA, Immunity 2017;47:820-33, PMID 29166586). 2) iPSC- AND CD34-DERIVED NK CELL PRODUCTS FOR ADOPTIVE IMMUNOTHERAPY. Current differentiation protocols yield predominantly CD56bright-phenotype cells, and the rationale that these will mature into cytotoxic CD56dim effectors in the patient rests on this claim. Cichocki/Grzywacz/Miller (Front Immunol 2019;10:2078) state the dependency explicitly: "It is possible that current culture systems which predominantly generate cells with a CD56bright phenotype favor the expansion/differentiation of a particular subset of precursor clones at the expense of other clones that differentiate into CD56dim NK cells." Named programmes in that lineage: the Miller/Cichocki (Univ. Minnesota) CD34-derived and Fate Therapeutics iPSC-NK (FT500/FT516) products. 3) INTERPRETATION OF POST-HSCT NK RECONSTITUTION. The CD56bright-then-CD56dim sequence after transplant is read as maturation rather than differential homeostatic expansion, and is used to time NK-based relapse prophylaxis and to judge "immune reconstitution quality". 4) THE "CD56bright = IMMATURE REGULATORY PRECURSOR" READING OF DACLIZUMAB IN MULTIPLE SCLEROSIS (Bielekova B et al. PNAS 2006;103:5941-6, PMID 16585503) and of CD56bright expansion in autoimmunity generally. 5) EVERY scRNA-seq PSEUDOTIME/VELOCITY PAPER THAT ROOTS ITS NK TRAJECTORY AT CD56bright AND ORIENTS IT TOWARD CD56dim BY ASSUMPTION — e.g. Yang C et al. Nat Commun 2019;10:3931 (PMID 31477722); Crinier et al. Immunity 2018; Cell Mol Immunol 2021;18:1290 (PMID 33239726, "trajectories of NK cell differentiation in bone marrow"); Front Immunol 2022 (PMID 36505452, "CD56dimGranzymeK+ subset as intermediate stage in NK cell differentiation"). These are INF_TRAJECTORY by rule G2 and they IMPORT the direction of the arrow from this claim rather than testing it — a circularity that makes the claim's failure propagate directly into their conclusions.
audit.audit_overturns_detail: Claude's initial call — "MOSTLY INFERENCE (telomere length, in vitro, reconstitution kinetics)" — is directionally correct about the bulk of the evidence but is wrong or incomplete in three specific ways, so I am changing it. (a) IT MISSED AN OBSERVATION-CLASS ARM. Chan 2007 did not only do in vitro work and telomere flow-FISH: it also adoptively transferred sorted human CD56bright NK cells into NOD-SCID mice and recovered CD56dimCD16+ human cells from blood, spleen and lymph node at day 10. By the spec's definitions that is OBS_TRANSFER, not inference, and it is therefore the strongest class present — so "MOSTLY INFERENCE" understates the ceiling. I record OBS_TRANSFER as strongest, with these caveats stated on the record: it is XENOGENEIC (human NK into a mouse host, a severe non-physiological bottleneck), it is a SINGLE unreplicated experiment in ~19 years, it used NO clonal marking so selection of contaminating CD56dim is not excluded, and — per rule G1 — I DID NOT READ ITS METHODS (n mice, cell dose, sort purity and control arms are unknown to me because the journal host is proxy-blocked and the paper is not in PMC). (b) THE "RECONSTITUTION KINETICS" LEG IS PARTLY MISATTRIBUTED. The human in vivo deuterium-labelling study usually invoked for NK turnover (Zhang 2007, PMID 17346281) sorted CD3-CD16+ NK cells only and did NOT resolve CD56bright from CD56dim, so it contributes nothing to this claim. What remains is post-HSCT flow-cytometry kinetics, which is INF_KINETIC and carries a stated confound (lymphopenia-driven homeostatic expansion of CD56bright), per Cichocki/Grzywacz/Miller 2019. (c) MOST IMPORTANTLY, THE INITIAL CALL DID NOT REGISTER THAT THE SINGLE STRONGEST-DESIGN EXPERIMENT IN THIS AREA RUNS AGAINST THE CLAIM. Clonal barcoding of transplanted CD34+ cells in 3 rhesus macaques tracked for 49-52 months (Wu 2018, Sci Immunol) — a clonal-marking design, i.e. a HIGHER evidence class than anything supporting the claim — found CD56+CD16- and CD56-CD16+ NK barcode repertoires "remained distinct... over several years" and concluded that linear production of CD16+ NK cells through a CD56+CD16- intermediate is "negligible" at homeostasis. Independently, 8 GATA2-deficient humans maintain a CD56dim pool while essentially lacking CD56bright (Mace 2013, Blood), which an obligate linear precursor relationship forbids. NET REVISED GRADE: not "mostly inference" but "INFERENCE-DOMINANT (INF_INVITRO + INF_MARKER/telomere + INF_KINETIC + INF_TRAJECTORY) WITH ONE UNREPLICATED, METHODS-UNVERIFIED, XENOGENEIC OBS_TRANSFER ARM, AND ACTIVELY CONTRADICTED BY HIGHER-CLASS CLONAL EVIDENCE." The claim as stated ("CD56bright NK -> CD56dim NK", implying the normal route by which CD56dim cells are made) should be treated as UNESTABLISHED and contested, not as settled lineage.
audit.methods_quote: Chan 2007's Methods could NOT be read (see fulltext_unavailable_reason), so no Methods quote from the primary is available and I will not paraphrase its abstract as if it were Methods. The closest methods-level statement I can source is a third-party description in a peer-reviewed OA review, quoted verbatim from Cichocki F, Grzywacz B, Miller JS, Front Immunol 2019;10:2078 (PMC6727427, archived at /home/user/aaa/refs/D3_PMC6727427.txt): "In a study by Chan et al., a fraction of sorted CD56bright NK cells co-cultured with synovial fibroblasts exhibited CD56 downregulation and had a phenotype consistent with CD56dim NK cells... Of note, stimulation of CD56bright NK cells with a combination of IL-2, IL-15, and 721.221 cells did not induce differentiation to a CD56dim phenotype. CD56bright NK cells that were adoptively transferred into NOD-SCID mice were almost uniformly CD56dimCD16+ when analyzed 10 days later in the blood, spleen, and lymph nodes." VERBATIM METHODS QUOTE FROM A PRIMARY I DID READ — Domaica CI et al., PLoS One 2012;7:e51677, Methods, "PBMCs and NK cells" (archived /home/user/aaa/refs/D3_PMC3519873.txt): "Human peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) and NK cells were isolated from blood of healthy volunteers or from the patient described in this work (called 'P') using Ficoll-Paque Plus (Amersham Biosciences) centrifugation and the RosetteSep kit (StemCell), respectively... Purity of isolated NK cells (CD3-CD56+ cells) was above 90%, as assessed by flow cytometry (FC). In some experiments, PBMCs were cultured with IL-2 (0.8 ng/ml) or IL-15 (10 ng/ml)... for up to 5 days." This is the whole of that paper's cellular method — despite a title asserting "In Vivo CD56bright to CD56dim Lineage Development", the study is flow cytometry on ONE patient plus cytokine culture, with no in vivo lineage measurement of any kind. VERBATIM COUNTER-EVIDENCE QUOTE — Wu C et al., Sci Immunol 2018;3:eaat9781 (PMC7393805): "the barcode composition of CD56+CD16- and CD56-CD16+ NK cells remained distinct under homeostatic conditions over several years"; sorting was "to >98% purity" in 3 macaques (ZH33, ZG66, ZJ31) tracked 49-52 months post-transplant.

audit.notes: RULE-COMPLIANCE NOTES. G1: I did not read Chan 2007 or Romagnani 2007 Methods and have said so explicitly rather than dressing up their abstracts; the what_was_measured field is flagged as abstract + third-party-derived for those two. G2: all scRNA-seq pseudotime/velocity work that orients a CD56bright-to-CD56dim trajectory (Yang 2019 Nat Commun; Cell Mol Immunol 2021 PMID 33239726; Front Immunol 2022 PMID 36505452; Front Immunol 2024 "naive-memory relationship") is classed INF_TRAJECTORY and contributes nothing evidentially — worse, it imports the arrow's direction from this very claim, so it is circular support. G3: counter_evidence_status = FOUND on searches I actually ran and read. I did NOT find any human clonal/somatic-mutation lineage-tracing study directly testing CD56bright-to-CD56dim; my searches for one returned nothing on point, so I record that as searched-and-not-found rather than nonexistent. G5: n is in donors/mice/patients/animals, never cells; where the count is unobtainable I say NOT STATED rather than inventing one. HINT CORRECTIONS: (i) "Chan et al. Cell Death Differ 2007 (telomere)" in the starting hints does not exist — Chan et al. 2007 is J Immunol 179:89-94 and it contains BOTH the telomere flow-FISH and the NOD-SCID transfer; searched and could not find any Cell Death Differ 2007 Chan NK paper. (ii) "Romagnani et al. J Immunol 2007 (in vitro)" is correct but incomplete — Romagnani 2007 also carries telomere flow-FISH and lymph-node/efferent-lymph marker profiling. (iii) The hint is right that telomere length is a correlate, not an observation of conversion: I classed Ouyang 2007 and the telomere arms of Chan/Romagnani as INF_MARKER. Note the specific weakness — shorter telomeres in CD56dim show only that CD56dim cells have divided more; two independently maintained lineages with different replicative histories (exactly what Wu 2018 reports: oligoclonal, self-renewing, expanding/contracting CD56-CD16+ clones) produce the same telomere gap with no precursor relationship. OBS_GENETIC IN evidence_types_all POINTS AGAINST, NOT FOR: the only genetic-necessity data here (GATA2, Mace 2013) shows CD56dim persisting when CD56bright is lost, i.e. it fails the necessity test that a linear model predicts. DIRECTION OF THE FIELD: the two 2007 primaries are ~19 years old, the FGFR1 mechanism has never been followed up, and the two most recent high-design studies (Wu 2018 macaque barcoding; Ding 2024 two-pathway ontogeny) both favour independent origins. adv.challenge_reason:
DOWNGRADE on two independent grounds — one procedural, one substantive.

(1) PROCEDURAL — the row's headline class is awarded to Methods that NOBODY in this audit chain has read. I independently re-verified the auditor's access failure rather than taking their word: EuropePMC core record for DOI 10.4049/jimmunol.179.1.89 returns pmcid=None, isOpenAccess=N, inEPMC=N, hasPDF=N, with the only "Free" locator an Unpaywall pointer to journals.aai.org. I then hit all three routes myself with curl: journals.aai.org/jimmunol/article-pdf/179/1/89/1242177/zim01307000089.pdf -> HTTP 403; doi.org/10.4049/jimmunol.179.1.89 -> redirects to academic.oup.com/jimmunol/article/179/1/89/8022276 -> HTTP 403; www.jimmunol.org/content/179/1/89.full.pdf -> HTTP 403. lit.py methods 17579025 returns STATUS=ABSTRACT_ONLY on three retries. CONFIRMED UNREADABLE. The auditor's own fulltext_unavailable_reason concedes "donor numbers, sort purity, mouse numbers, cell dose and control arms of the NOD-SCID experiment are therefore UNKNOWN to me" — and then makes that same experiment the row's evidence_type_strongest. That is internally inconsistent and violates G1: the class was derived from an abstract sentence ("in vivo, upon transfer into NOD-SCID mice") plus a review's paraphrase (Cichocki 2019), which is precisely the substitution G1 forbids. A class you cannot verify cannot be the row's ceiling. The strongest class supported by any Methods section ACTUALLY READ in this audit is INF_INVITRO.

(2) SUBSTANTIVE — the readout used in the transfer arm is now known to be bidirectional, which strips the design of its ability to orient an arrow even if the Methods were readable. Chan's NOD-SCID arm measures exactly one thing: surface CD56/CD16 density on recovered human cells. Keskin 2007 PNAS (PMID 17360654, Methods READ via PMC1805591) ran the same class of experiment on the same axis four months EARLIER and got the opposite direction, with better-documented purity than Chan (see new_counter_evidence). And Van Acker 2017 documents that an immunosuppressive milieu downregulates CD56 with loss of cytotoxicity (citing Reiners 2013) — a xenogeneic NOD-SCID host lacking human IL-15 is such a milieu. So "sorted CD56bright were CD56dimCD16+ at day 10 in a mouse" has a fully non-developmental reading that the design cannot exclude.

(3) A THIRD, SMALLER ERROR: evidence_types_all lists OBS_GENETIC among the classes present for this claim. The only genetic-necessity datum here (GATA2, Mace 2013) points AGAINST the claim — the auditor says so themselves in their notes. Listing it as a class "present" inflates the apparent evidence base and violates G7. Remove it from the supporting list.

I did NOT find the auditor guilty of the opposite error: I searched specifically for a lineage-tracing/barcoding/congenic experiment SUPPORTING bright->dim that they might have missed, and found none (see crossfield/counter searches). Six E et al. Blood 2020;135:1219 (PMID 32040546), the largest human vector-integration-site clonal-tracking study, tracks NK cells as ONE lineage and does not resolve CD56bright from CD56dim — I read its record and grepped the archived text for CD56/NK subset language: nothing. So no UPGRADE is available.
adv.revised_evidence_type_strongest: INF_INVITRO — this is the strongest class supported by a Methods section actually read by anyone in this audit chain (Keskin 2007 Methods read via PMC1805591; Domaica 2012 Methods read via PMC3519873). OBS_TRANSFER should be recorded as CLAIMED-BUT-UNVERIFIED: the Chan 2007 NOD-SCID arm matches the spec's OBS_TRANSFER definition ("A transferred, B recovered from the recipient") as DESCRIBED in its abstract and in Cichocki 2019's paraphrase, but its Methods are unobtainable (403 on all three hosts, no PMC deposit), so n mice, cell dose, sort purity, input day-0 phenotype and control arms are unknown, it carries no clonal or congenic marking, and it has stood unreplicated for ~19 years. Full class list, corrected: INF_INVITRO (Chan fibroblast co-culture; Romagnani cytokine culture; and counter-directionally Keskin 2007), INF_MARKER (telomere flow-FISH in Ouyang 2007 / Chan 2007 / Romagnani 2007; LN vs efferent-lymph vs PB marker profiling; Yu 2010 CD94 density; Ding 2024 human arm), INF_KINETIC (post-HSCT flow kinetics, confounded by lymphopenia-driven homeostatic expansion), INF_TRAJECTORY (all scRNA-seq pseudotime/velocity work, circular), OBS_TRANSFER-UNVERIFIED (Chan NOD-SCID xenograft). OBS_GENETIC struck from the supporting list — the only genetic data (GATA2/Mace 2013) is counter-evidence.
adv.new_counter_evidence:
THE BIG MISS — A REVERSE-DIRECTION CONVERSION EXPERIMENT, SAME AXIS, SAME EVIDENCE CLASS, PUBLISHED FIRST, WITH BETTER-DOCUMENTED PURITY THAN CHAN.

Keskin DB, Allan DSJ, Rybalov B, Andzelm MM, Stern JNH, Kopcow HD, Koopman LA, Strominger JL. "TGFbeta promotes conversion of CD16+ peripheral blood NK cells into CD16- NK cells with similarities to decidual NK cells." Proc Natl Acad Sci USA 2007;104(9):3378-83. PMID 17360654 / PMC1805591. Published 27 Feb 2007 — BEFORE Romagnani (15 Apr 2007) and BEFORE Chan (1 Jul 2007). METHODS READ (WebFetch on PMC1805591), verbatim: CD16+ pNK cells were "sorted to very high purity (i.e., the contamination with CD16- pNK cells was <0.1%)"; cultured "for 2-3 weeks in 24-well plates (10^6 cells in 1 ml)" with "20 ng/ml IL-15, and 20 ng/ml SCF" plus TGF-beta1 (2 or 10 ng/ml) or decidual-stromal-cell conditioned medium; CD56+CD16- outgrowth seen in "12 of 16 independent experiments"; n=17 for the conditioned-medium TGF-beta1 measurements. Authors' verbatim conclusion: "The data are most consistent with a conversion of cells from CD16+ to CD16-, under the influence of TGFbeta, accompanied by proliferation." And on the other marker: "both culture conditions appeared to increase the intensity of CD56 staining."

WHY THIS IS FATAL AND WHY THE AUDITOR'S "NOT FOUND" WAS WRONG. The auditor ran 'CD56dim NK cells give rise to CD56bright plasticity reverse', got 0 hits, and recorded the reverse-direction alternative as searched-and-not-found. It exists, it is 19 years old, and it is sitting in the reference list of Collins et al. Cell 2019 (PMID 30595449), which I pulled. Keskin is the SAME evidence class (INF_INVITRO), the SAME readout (surface CD56/CD16 on prospectively sorted subsets under a stromal-derived factor), and it is the ONE of the two that actually reports its sort purity (<0.1% contamination) and explicitly argues conversion over outgrowth of contaminants. Chan's purity is unknown to me and to the previous auditor. Consequence: the CD56/CD16 axis is a bidirectional, microenvironment-driven phenotype axis — FGFR1/fibroblast contact pushes one way, TGF-beta pushes the other — not a lineage arrow. Any experiment whose sole readout is CD56/CD16 surface density therefore cannot fix the direction of the arrow, and that includes Chan's NOD-SCID arm.

SECOND MISS — CD56 BRIGHTNESS IS AN ACTIVATION-STATE VARIABLE, DOCUMENTED IN HUMANS BOTH WAYS. Van Acker HH, Capsomidis A, Smits EL, Van Tendeloo VF. "CD56 in the Immune System: More Than a Marker for Cytotoxicity?" Front Immunol 2017;8:892 (PMID 28791027). Read via WebFetch, verbatim: "Upon activation, CD56dim NK cells can adopt a CD56bright-like immunophenotype or upregulate their CD56 expression in general" (citing Garcia-Cuesta 2017, Richter 2013, Vukicevic 2010); "Upon DC vaccine-mediated activation, both CD56bright and CD56dim NK cell subsets upregulate their expression of CD56"; and, directly relevant to the xenograft readout, "NK cells exposed to an immunosuppressive milieu downregulate their CD56 expression, concomitant with abolition of their cytotoxicity" (citing Reiners 2013). A NOD-SCID host with no human IL-15 and no HLA-matched stroma is an immunosuppressive/starved milieu, so CD56 dimming there is an expected stress phenotype independent of any maturation.

THIRD MISS — A HUMAN PRIMARY SHOWING BOTH DIRECTIONS MOVING IN THE SAME CULTURE. Garcia-Cuesta EM et al. "Characterization of a human anti-tumoral NK cell population expanded after BCG treatment of leukocytes." OncoImmunology 2017;6(4):e1293212. PMID 28507799 / PMC5414876. Abstract verbatim: "after BCG stimulation, CD56dim NK cells proliferate, upregulate CD56, but maintain the expression of CD16 and the ability to mediate ADCC. CD56bright NK cells also contribute to this expansion by increasing CD16 and KIR expression." Both subsets move along both markers under one stimulus — the axis is an activation readout.

FOURTH — THE DECISIVE HUMAN EXPERIMENT HAS NEVER BEEN RUN, AND I VERIFIED THAT RATHER THAN ASSUMING IT. Six E et al. Blood 2020;135:1219-31 (PMID 32040546), vector-integration-site clonal tracking in Wiskott-Aldrich and beta-hemoglobinopathy gene-therapy patients, tracked five lineages "(granulocytes, monocytes, T cells, B cells, and natural killer cells)" — NK as ONE lineage, no CD56bright/CD56dim split (record read; archived text grepped for CD56/NK subset language, nothing). Ludwig LS et al. Cell 2019;176:1325 (PMID 30827679) established mtDNA-mutation lineage tracing in humans, i.e. the tool that could settle this now exists. It has not been applied to these two subsets. SEARCHED AND NOT FOUND — not nonexistent.

I did NOT find a failed formal replication of the Chan NOD-SCID transfer; I searched for one and found nothing either way, which is itself the finding — Cichocki 2019 (verified verbatim in the archived PMC6727427): "it's somewhat surprising that no follow up studies looking deeper into the FGF signaling pathway and its role in driving NK cell maturation have been published."

The auditor's existing counter-evidence (Wu 2018 macaque barcoding PMID 30389798; Mace 2013 GATA2 PMID 23365458; Ding 2024 PMID 38872000; Cichocki 2019 PMID 31555287) I re-checked and it stands. Add: Allan DSJ et al. Sci Rep 2017;7:3501 (PMID 28615725 / PMC5471261), "Transcriptome analysis reveals similarities between human blood CD3- CD56bright cells and mouse CD127+ innate lymphoid cells" — human CD56bright resemble helper ILCs rather than cytotoxic-NK precursors, an independent 2017 antecedent of the two-pathway model that the auditor did not cite.
adv.crossfield_g4_findings:
THE BORROWED PROCESS: "a marker-defined, cytokine-producing subset is the obligate precursor of a marker-defined cytotoxic effector subset, inferred from marker overlap + longer telomeres + greater proliferative potential + adoptive transfer into a host." Three fields have already run this play, and two of them broke it.

(A) T CELL FIELD — THE ARROW RAN BACKWARD ON EXACTLY THIS INFERENCE. Wherry EJ, Teichgraber V, Becker TC, Masopust D, Kaech SM, Antia R, von Andrian UH, Ahmed R. "Lineage relationship and protective immunity of memory CD8 T cell subsets." Nat Immunol 2003;4(3):225-34. PMID 12563257. (I read the PubMed record/abstract, archived at /home/user/aaa/refs/D3_12563257.txt; I did NOT read its Methods — Nat Immunol 2003 is not in PMC.) Verbatim from the record: "We also demonstrate that, following antigen clearance, T(EM) convert to T(CM)... We propose that T(CM) and T(EM) do not necessarily represent distinct subsets, but are part of a continuum in a linear naive --> effector --> T(EM) --> T(CM) differentiation pathway." CD62L/CCR7-defined Tcm were widely assumed to be the precursor of Tem on precisely the CD56bright logic — less-differentiated surface phenotype, longer telomeres, greater proliferative potential, lymph-node homing. Sorted-subset adoptive transfer showed the opposite. THE COLLISION: in the field where this inference pattern was tested hardest, "longer telomeres + more proliferative + LN-homing = the precursor" was WRONG about direction. Ouyang 2007 (PMID 17303822) and the telomere flow-FISH arms of Chan 2007 and Romagnani 2007 make identically-structured arguments and inherit the identical failure mode: shorter telomeres in CD56dim establish only that CD56dim have divided more, which two independently maintained lineages with different replicative histories also produce. Same field, same lesson from the other end: Herndler-Brandstetter et al. Immunity 2018;48:716 (PMID 29625895) — "KLRG1+ Effector CD8+ T Cells Lose KLRG1, Differentiate into All Memory T Cell Lineages" — a canonical "terminal differentiation" surface marker is reversible.

(B) MYELOID FIELD — THIS EXACT QUESTION WAS SETTLED IN HUMANS WITH A TOOL NOBODY HAS APPLIED TO NK SUBSETS; AND SEPARATELY, TRANSFER-INTO-AN-EMPTY-HOST IS A KNOWN ARTEFACT GENERATOR.
(i) THE STANDARD THAT WAS MET. Patel AA, Zhang Y, Fullerton JN, ..., Yona S. "The fate and lifespan of human monocyte subsets in steady state and systemic inflammation." J Exp Med 2017;214(7):1913-23. PMID 28606987 / PMC5502436 — MEHODS AND RESULTS READ (archived /home/user/aaa/refs/D3_PMC5502436.txt). Design in humans in vivo: a 3-h pulse of 6,6-2H2-glucose in healthy volunteers, then flow-SORTED classical/intermediate/nonclassical monocyte subsets at sequential timepoints, deuterium incorporation into DNA measured, fitted to an explicit compartment ODE model with a delay-vs-no-delay model comparison (Fig. S2, Table S1). Verbatim: "there was no deuterium labeling for the first 24 h after administration, consistent with a postmitotic 'maturation' phase preceding release from bone marrow into the circulation"; and crucially "we excluded models in which circulating subsets proliferate in the blood on the basis of (1) the absence of any deuterium enrichment in such cells 24 h after labeling and (2) the absence of markers of cell cycling." THAT is what an in-vivo human subset-lineage claim looks like when it is actually tested: a pulse-chase label, prospectively sorted subsets, and the competing selection/proliferation model explicitly excluded BY DATA. Nothing of this kind exists for CD56bright->CD56dim. The only NK deuterium study (Zhang 2007, PMID 17346281) sorted CD3-CD16+ only and did not resolve the subsets — the auditor got that right. My own search 'NK cell subsets deuterium in vivo labelling humans' returned zero. So the human label-chase test of this claim HAS NOT BEEN DONE, and the neighbouring field shows it is entirely doable.
(ii) THE STRUCTURAL WARNING ABOUT NOD-SCID. Yona S et al. "Fate mapping reveals origins and dynamics of monocytes and tissue macrophages under homeostasis." Immunity 2013;38:79-91, PMID 23273845; Hashimoto D et al. "Tissue-resident macrophages self-maintain locally throughout adult life with minimal contribution from circulating monocytes." Immunity 2013;38:792-804, PMID 23601688. (Titles/records located via lit.py; I did NOT read their Methods.) Decades of adoptive-transfer and in-vitro-culture data "showed" that blood monocytes become tissue macrophages. Genetic fate mapping and parabiosis showed that at homeostasis they largely do not — the transfer experiments worked because the recipient niche had been emptied by irradiation. THE COLLISION: transfer into a vacant/lymphopenic niche is a documented manufacturer of differentiation routes that do not operate at homeostasis. Chan's arm is transfer of human cells into a profoundly lymphopenic xenogeneic host. And the NK field already has its own version of the myeloid resolution: Wu 2018 (PMID 30389798) reports barcode repertoires of CD56+CD16- and CD56-CD16+ macaque NK "remained distinct under homeostatic conditions over several years" with linear production "negligible" at homeostasis — homeostasis and transplant/stress give different answers, exactly as in the macrophage story.
(iii) THE CONTROL CASE. The linear model DID survive in monocytes — but only because someone ran the label-chase. That contrast is the point: the myeloid field did not accept the linear model on transfer + marker + kinetics alone.

(C) ILC FIELD — THE MARKER/CYTOKINE AXIS IS PLASTIC AND BIDIRECTIONAL, AND THE SAME CYTOKINES ROMAGNANI USED ARE THE ONES THAT SWITCH ILC IDENTITY.
(i) Ohne Y, Silver JS, Thompson-Snipes L, et al. "IL-1 is a critical regulator of group 2 innate lymphoid cell function and plasticity." Nat Immunol 2016;17:646-55. PMID 27111142 (record located; Methods NOT read). ILC2 acquire an ILC1-like phenotype under IL-1beta/IL-12 — surface- and cytokine-defined "subsets" interconvert under cytokine exposure with no lineage change. Romagnani 2007's entire in vitro arm is IL-2/IL-15/IL-12 driven, i.e. the identity-switching cytokine cocktail of the neighbouring field.
(ii) Lim AI, Li Y, Lopez-Lastra S, ..., Di Santo JP. "Systemic Human ILC Precursors Provide a Substrate for Tissue ILC Differentiation." Cell 2017;168:1086-1100. PMID 28283063 (record read; Methods not in PMC). The methodological BAR the ILC field demanded of a human-blood-precursor claim: single-cell clonal in vitro assays, epigenetic poising of the signature loci, AND in vivo humanized-mouse reconstitution — and it still drew two immediate critical commentaries (Nat Rev Immunol 2017;17:216, PMID 28317924; Immunity 2017;46:344, PMID 28329700). Chan 2007 supplies a bulk sorted transfer with a two-marker flow readout and no clonal assay. By the standards of the field this claim's mechanism is borrowed from, it would not clear the bar.
(iii) NK CELLS THEMSELVES SIT ON THE PLASTIC SIDE OF THIS BOUNDARY, DRIVEN BY THE SAME CYTOKINE AS THE REVERSE-DIRECTION NK RESULT. Cortez VS et al. "SMAD4 impedes the conversion of NK cells into ILC1-like cells by curtailing non-canonical TGF-beta signaling." Nat Immunol 2017;18:995-1003, PMID 28759002 (mouse, genetic). Human: "Interleukin-35 impairs human NK cell effector functions and induces their ILC1-like conversion with tissue residency features." Nat Commun 2025, PMID 40610398. THE CONVERGENCE THAT THE NK LITERATURE HAS NOT ABSORBED: TGF-beta is simultaneously (a) the signal that in Keskin 2007 drives human CD16+ NK "backward" to CD16-CD56bright-like decidual-type cells, and (b) the signal that in Cortez 2017 drives NK out of the NK compartment into ILC1. What the ILC field files as environment-driven plasticity, the NK field is reading as a fixed developmental step. If the NK/ILC1 boundary itself is TGF-beta- and IL-35-modulable, an intra-NK boundary marked only by NCAM1 surface density is a very poor candidate for an obligate lineage step.

NET CROSS-FIELD VERDICT: the T cell field falsified the direction of this exact inference; the myeloid field falsified the transfer-into-empty-host assay and then supplied the human pulse-chase design that would settle it; the ILC field showed the cytokines used in the supporting in vitro arms are identity-switching agents, and set a clonal-assay bar this claim does not meet. All three collisions are invisible to NK keywords.

adv.load_bearing_reason:
The auditor listed five dependencies and graded HIGH. Two survive, one is circular-but-real, and two are generous. Net = MEDIUM.

SURVIVES, AND IS THE ONE CONCRETE NAMED DEPENDENCY: the Freud/Caligiuri five-stage human NK development model — Freud AG, Becknell B, Roychowdhury S, et al. Immunity 2005;22:295-304 (PMID 15780987); Freud AG, Yokohama A, Becknell B, et al. J Exp Med 2006;203:1033-43 (PMID 16606675); Freud AG, Mundy-Bosse BL, Yu J, Caligiuri MA. Immunity 2017;47:820-33 (PMID 29166586). Stage 4 = CD56bright, stage 5 = CD56dim; the stage-4-to-stage-5 arrow IS this claim, and the model is the standard staging framework for human NK development in bone marrow, tonsil and lymph node. I add a SHARPER, BETTER-SPECIFIED dependency than any the auditor named, found in Collins 2019's reference list: Yu J, Mao HC, Wei M, et al. Caligiuri MA. "CD94 surface density identifies a functional intermediary between the CD56bright and CD56dim human NK-cell subsets." Blood 2010;115:274-81, PMID 19897577. The word "intermediary" is DEFINITIONALLY load-bearing — that paper's central object has no referent if CD56bright is not upstream of CD56dim. Same for Front Immunol 2022 PMID 36505452 ("CD56dimGranzymeK+ subset as intermediate stage in NK cell differentiation").

SURVIVES BUT IS CIRCULAR (agree with auditor): every scRNA-seq pseudotime/velocity paper that roots the NK trajectory at CD56bright and orients it toward CD56dim (Yang 2019 Nat Commun PMID 31477722; Cell Mol Immunol 2021 PMID 33239726; Front Immunol 2022 PMID 36505452). By G2 these are INF_TRAJECTORY and import the arrow's direction rather than testing it. Circular support is a dependency, but a self-inflicted one — it does not raise real-world load.

GENEROUS #1 — DACLIZUMAB / MULTIPLE SCLEROSIS SHOULD BE STRUCK. The auditor claims Bielekova et al. PNAS 2006;103:5941 (PMID 16585503) depends on a "CD56bright = immature regulatory PRECURSOR" reading. It does not. That work rests on CD56bright being IL-2Ralpha-high, cytokine-producing and capable of killing autologous activated T cells — properties established independently of any precursor relationship. Blocking CD25 expands CD56bright and the immunoregulatory argument stands intact whether or not CD56bright ever becomes CD56dim. Nothing clinical changes if the arrow is wrong. Remove.

GENEROUS #2 — THE iPSC/CD34-NK THERAPEUTIC DEPENDENCY IS OVERSTATED. The auditor asserts the rationale for CD56bright-phenotype cell products (Fate FT500/FT516; Miller/Cichocki CD34-NK) "rests on this claim" — i.e. that they will mature into cytotoxic CD56dim in the patient. That is not the stated rationale for those products, which are dosed as terminally functional effectors carrying engineered high-affinity non-cleavable CD16 and IL-15 modules precisely so they do NOT depend on in-patient maturation to acquire ADCC. And the sentence the auditor quotes from Cichocki/Grzywacz/Miller 2019 (which I verified verbatim in the archived PMC6727427: "It is possible that current culture systems which predominantly generate cells with a CD56bright phenotype favor the expansion/differentiation of a particular subset of precursor clones at the expense of other clones that differentiate into CD56dim NK cells") is a SPECULATIVE CAVEAT raised against the claim, not a programme built on it. Downgrade to a soft dependency at most.

GENEROUS #3 — POST-HSCT RECONSTITUTION "QUALITY". Clinicians track the CD56bright fraction as a reconstitution marker regardless of whether it is a precursor; and the field's own review already supplies the competing reading, verified verbatim in the archive: "an alternative hypothesis is that the abundance of CD56 bright NK cells early post-transplant is due to high levels of homeostatic expansion of this subset in the setting of lymphopenia induced by transplant conditioning" (Cichocki 2019). A dependency the field has already publicly hedged is not carrying much weight.

THE TEST THAT DECIDES HIGH vs MEDIUM: is there a therapeutic decision, dosing rule or diagnostic threshold that CHANGES if the arrow is wrong? None of the five survives that test. What is genuinely load-bearing is a conceptual framework (the stage model) plus a body of papers whose central noun ("intermediary", "intermediate stage") presupposes the arrow. That is real and citable, but it is MEDIUM, not HIGH. Notably, the field's own review already calls this "perhaps the most controversial step in this developmental model" (Cichocki 2019, verified verbatim) — a step the field openly flags as contested is, by construction, one it has been careful not to build hard on.
adv.better_primary_source:
NONE for a better primary SUPPORTING the claim — Chan 2007 (PMID 17579025) and Romagnani 2007 (PMID 17404276) remain the earliest primaries that actually tested bright->dim conversion, and I confirmed the earlier antecedents the auditor named (Nagler/Lanier J Immunol 1989;143:3183, PMID 2530273; Jacobs et al. Eur J Immunol 2001;31:3121, PMID 11592089) are marker comparisons that did not test conversion. My search for a lineage-tracing/barcoding/congenic experiment supporting the claim that the auditor might have missed returned nothing, so no UPGRADE is available.

BUT THE AUDITOR PICKED THE WRONG EARLIEST PRIMARY ON THE AXIS ITSELF. The first 2007 experiment to prospectively sort a human NK subset and culture it into the other CD56/CD16 phenotype is Keskin DB, Allan DSJ, Rybalov B, Andzelm MM, Stern JNH, Kopcow HD, Koopman LA, Strominger JL, PNAS 2007;104(9):3378-83, PMID 17360654 / PMC1805591, published 27 Feb 2007 — ahead of Romagnani (15 Apr 2007) and Chan (1 Jul 2007) — and it runs the arrow the OTHER way (CD16+ -> CD16-, with CD56 staining intensity increasing), with an explicitly stated sort purity (<0.1% CD16- contamination) that neither 2007 bright->dim primary can be checked against because their Methods are inaccessible. Any honest primary-source record for this claim must carry Keskin 2007 alongside Chan 2007, because they are the same experiment run in opposite directions and only one of them documents the contamination control.

ACCESS STATUS, RE-VERIFIED INDEPENDENTLY (not taken from the prior row): Chan 2007 and Romagnani 2007 Methods remain UNREADABLE. EuropePMC core record for 10.4049/jimmunol.179.1.89 returns pmcid=None, isOpenAccess=N, inEPMC=N, hasPDF=N. My own curl attempts: journals.aai.org article-pdf -> HTTP 403; doi.org -> academic.oup.com/jimmunol/article/179/1/89/8022276 -> HTTP 403; www.jimmunol.org/content/179/1/89.full.pdf -> HTTP 403.
